## git-repo 0.13.0

- Added and updated scripts for improved worktree pruning (`prune_merged_worktrees.py` and tests).
- Updated documentation (CHANGELOG.md).
- Removed obsolete file: `skill-card.md`.

- Added new "safe-relocate" topic and guide for moving commits onto a clean base branch
- Removed obsolete file: skill-card.md
- Updated documentation and topic tables to include the new "safe-relocate" command
- Minor content and structure improvements across guides and topic dependencies

- Added script to prune merged worktrees: `scripts/prune_merged_worktrees.py`.
- Added corresponding test: `tests/test_prune_merged_worktrees.py`.
- Updated documentation in `SKILL.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`.
- Removed deprecated or obsolete file: `skill-card.md`.

- Added new and updated tests for git-repo-doctor.sh to improve test coverage and reliability.
- Made changes to the scripts/git-repo-doctor.sh script (details not shown).
- Updated documentation in CHANGELOG.md.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Improved repository doctor script and documentation for diagnosing git hook health and CI compliance.
- Updated doctor.md usage details to match enhancements in scripts/git-repo-doctor.sh.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- General documentation refinements for clarity and consistency.

- Removed deprecated `skill-card.md` file.
- Updated and clarified guides: `doctor.md`, `rebase-audit.md`, `rename-worktree.md`.
- Improved and expanded the scripts: `scripts/git-repo-doctor.sh`, `tests/test-git-repo-doctor.sh`.
- Updated CHANGELOG.md with recent changes.
- Documentation and health-check improvements for the "doctor" feature.

**New feature: Comprehensive Git repository hook health check (doctor)**

- Added "doctor" topic for diagnosing Git repository hook health, wiring, file permissions, and CI compliance (Base + Conditional taxonomy).
- Introduced `doctor.md` guide and supporting scripts for automated repository checks.
- Updated documentation to include new "doctor" capabilities and troubleshooting triggers.
- Removed obsolete "skill-card.md" file.
- Expanded tests to cover the new "doctor" functionality.

- Removed skill-card.md (retired file).
- Updated internal documentation in multiple guides: clone.md, to-bare.md, to-ghq.md, and worktree.md.
- Minor corrections and refinements made to guide content and topic descriptions.
- No new user-facing features or major functionality changes.

- Added new `githooks` topic for diagnosing hooks not firing due to hooksPath precedence and install methods, with a dedicated guide.
- Expanded troubleshooting triggers and usage descriptions to cover githooks issues: "githooks ignored", "hook not running", "core.hooksPath", "hook not firing".
- Updated worktree decision tree to include detection and handling of squash-merged PR worktrees using GitHub PR state, not just commit hashes.
- Removed outdated `skill-card.md`, reflecting structural guide changes.
- Minor improvements and clarifications across documentation topics and guides.

git-repo v0.8.1

- Updated documentation for worktree and rename-worktree topics.
- Improved and clarified usage instructions in rename-worktree.md and worktree.md.
- Minor script adjustments in scripts/rename-worktree.sh to improve reliability.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Added two new topics: `rebase-audit` (audit active interactive rebases for accidental reverts) and `worktree-drift-sync` (coordinate safe fixes across multiple worktrees).
- Updated topic descriptions for improved clarity and conciseness.
- Removed `skill-card.md` file, streamlining documentation.
- Updated documentation references to include new topics and reflect latest workflow patterns.

- Added scripts/check-worktree-canonical.sh and accompanying automated test (tests/test-check-worktree-canonical.sh) for worktree canonical path verification.
- Updated documentation for move-worktree, rename-worktree, and worktree topics.
- Improved or fixed scripts/stage-isolated-content.sh.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Updated documentation in `CHANGELOG.md` and `worktree.md`.
- Removed `skill-card.md` file.
- No changes to core features or interface.

## git-repo 0.7.0

- Added "isolate-hunk" topic: enables staging only your own edit in a file with mixed uncommitted changes, using git plumbing.
- New guide: `isolate-hunk.md` and helper script: `scripts/stage-isolated-content.sh`.
- Updated SKILL.md to document the "isolate-hunk" capability and user triggers.
- Improved worktree and staging workflows documentation.
- Removed deprecated `skill-card.md` file.

- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Updated documentation in CHANGELOG.md, SKILL.md, scripts/local-to-staging-pr.sh, and worktree.md for clarity and accuracy.
- No user-facing feature changes; update is documentation and cleanup only.

Version 0.6.0

- Added new topics: conflict-dry-run (isolated merge/cherry-pick test) and credential-helper (per-org HTTPS token management).
- Updated SKILL.md description and topic table to include new topics and usage triggers.
- Expanded worktree reuse rules with an "operation-state gate" to prevent unsafe reuse of worktrees involved in in-progress git operations.
- Documented SSH/HTTPS multi-account support split between ssh-key and credential-helper.
- Removed outdated file: skill-card.md.

## git-repo 0.5.0

- Added `scripts/local-to-staging-pr.sh` utility script.
- Updated guides and documentation for worktree operations: `rename-worktree.md`, `worktree.md`, and others.
- Improved or clarified CHANGELOG.md and SKILL.md documentation.
- Removed deprecated `skill-card.md` file.

- Added README.md with documentation overview.
- Updated and clarified guides: CHANGELOG.md, rename-worktree.md, worktree-register.md, worktree.md.
- Improved scripts/rename-worktree.sh for reliability and clarity.
- Documentation improvements and refactoring across major topics.

- Removed skill-card.md to streamline documentation.
- Updated scripts/repo-to-bare-worktree.sh (details not shown here; possible script improvements or bug fixes).
- Minor documentation or changelog updates.

- Improves worktree management scripts for better reliability and cross-platform compatibility.
- Updates `rename-worktree.md` and related scripts for enhanced directory and metadata rename workflows.
- Removes outdated documentation file (`skill-card.md`).
- Updates CHANGELOG and topic guides for clarity and alignment with current functionality.

**Major: Bare repo and migration workflow rework; new conversion and registration topics.**

- Added "to-bare" topic: convert regular repo to bare+worktree setup, preserving uncommitted changes.
- Added "to-ghq" topic: migrate bare+worktree to regular `.git` at the ghq path (was "migrate"; now an alias).
- Introduced "worktree-register" shared topic for metadata-based worktree registration, used by fix-worktree and to-bare.
- Added guides: to-bare.md, to-ghq.md, worktree-register.md; new bare conversion script.
- Updated documentation and topic table to clarify dependencies and migration flow.
- Removed obsolete guide (skill-card.md); marked "migrate" as deprecated in favor of "to-ghq".

- Shortened and clarified the SKILL.md description for easier understanding.
- Removed redundant/verbose trigger and topic keyword lists from the SKILL.md header.
- Minor formatting improvements for topic list and guides.
- Removed the obsolete `skill-card.md` file.

- Updated documentation in CHANGELOG.md and ssh-key.md.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No functional or code changes; documentation only.

## git-repo v0.3.0

- Added comprehensive worktree management: unified worktree workflow, inactive worktree reuse, move/reclaim, and cross-platform renaming.
- Introduced per-repo SSH key mapping for multi-account GitHub support via `ssh-key` topic.
- Added new topics: `move-worktree`, `rename-worktree`, and `worktree`; included detailed guides for each.
- Worktree workflow now recommends reuse before creating new, with clear user decision flow.
- Expanded documentation and guides for all new topics and workflows.
- Added utility scripts for worktree movement and renaming.
Add fix-worktree topic for bare repo worktree configuration recovery
Bump metadata version to 0.1.1
Initial release: clone, fix-worktree, merge-duplicate, migrate, patrol, sourcegit
